issues.description: The new parallel-verification warning uses `OwoColorize` and `Stream` on every platform while importing them only on Windows.
issues.rationale: On Linux and macOS, `cfg(target_os = "windows")` removes the `owo_colors` import, but `exec_verify` unconditionally compiles `.if_supports_color(Stream::Stderr, ...)` whenever the crate is built. The trait and `Stream` type are therefore out of scope and the xtask fails to compile. Direct child commit c450c77d removes the Windows-only cfg from the import, matching the unconditional warning use. Primary and independent review confirmed the platform condition and one-line repair.
issues.source_evidence:
after/xtask/src/main.rs
21: #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
22: use owo_colors::{OwoColorize, Stream};

573: "Warning: Running verification in parallel mode, the output may be out of order."
574:     .if_supports_color(Stream::Stderr, |text| text.yellow())

Repair c450c77d removes line 21's cfg attribute.
issues.verification: Primary and independent source review confirmed the non-Windows name-resolution failure and direct repair. A historical cargo build was not executed.
